documents.title: Privacy policy
documents.intro: This policy explains what personal information Invenio Homes collects, why we collect it, and the choices you have. It applies to this website and to enquiries made through it.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
paragraphs: Invenio Homes S.L. (NIF B16649519), with its office in Santa Eulària des Riu, Ibiza, is the controller of the personal data collected through this website.
For any question about this policy or your data, write to find@inveniohomes.com.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: When you send an enquiry we collect the details you choose to give us: your name, email address, telephone number, the dates and destination you are interested in, and anything you write in the message.

We also receive basic technical information when you visit the site — the pages you view, the device and browser you use, and the approximate region you are connecting from. We use this only to understand how the site is working.

sections.heading: Why we use it
paragraphs: We use your information to answer your enquiry, to prepare a selection or an offer, to manage a booking or an owner relationship, and to keep records we are required to keep.
We do not sell your data, and we do not add you to a marketing list without asking.

sections.heading: Legal bases
paragraphs: Where you ask us to do something before entering a contract, we rely on that step being taken at your request. Where we manage an existing relationship, we rely on the performance of the contract. For essential site security and fraud prevention, we rely on our legitimate interest. Where consent is required — for example for non-essential cookies — we ask for it separately and you can withdraw it at any time.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Enquiries that do not lead to a booking are kept for 24 months. Booking and accounting records are kept for the period required by Spanish law. You can ask us to delete anything we are not legally required to keep.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We share information only where it is needed to deliver the service: with the owner or agency responsible for a property, with our booking and accounting providers, and with professional advisers. Those providers are bound by confidentiality and data-processing terms.
Some providers may process data outside the European Economic Area. Where that happens, we use appropriate safeguards, including the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access your data, correct it, delete it, restrict or object to its use, and receive it in a portable format. You also have the right to withdraw consent at any time.

Write to find@inveniohomes.com and we will respond within one month. If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the Spanish data protection authority (AEPD) or the authority in your country of residence.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy to reflect changes in the law or in our service. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last reviewed.

documents.title: Cookie policy
documents.intro: This site is built to work without tracking you. We use a small number of essential technologies, and we ask before using anything else.

sections.heading: What a cookie is
paragraphs: A cookie is a small file stored by your browser. It can remember a preference, keep a session secure, or help a site understand how it is being used. Some similar technologies — local storage, pixels — work in comparable ways, and this policy covers them too.

sections.heading: Essential
paragraphs: These are required for the site to function and cannot be switched off. They include the session used by the Studio if you are an editor, and a preference that remembers whether you have seen the opening sequence. They contain no advertising identifiers.

sections.heading: Analytics
paragraphs: If analytics are enabled, they are only loaded after you consent. We use them to count visits and understand which pages are useful. We do not use them to build a profile of you across other websites, and we do not sell the data.

sections.heading: Third parties
paragraphs: A page may embed a map, a video or a booking widget from another provider. Those providers may set their own cookies when the embed loads. We ask before loading non-essential embeds where the law requires it.

sections.heading: Managing cookies
paragraphs: You can clear or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may stop parts of the site from working. To withdraw consent for analytics, use the cookie preferences link in the footer or contact us.

documents.title: Terms of use
documents.intro: These terms govern your use of this website. They are not the terms of a booking — those are agreed separately, in writing, with the relevant owner or agency.

sections.heading: The website
paragraphs: This site presents a curated portfolio of properties and information about the Invenio platform. We work to keep it accurate, but availability, rates, photography and descriptions can change. Nothing on this site is an offer capable of acceptance.
A property is confirmed only when a written booking confirmation has been issued and the agreed deposit has been received.

sections.heading: Use of the site
paragraphs: You may view, download and print pages for your own use. You may not scrape the site, reproduce the photography, copy the portfolio for a competing service, or use the site in a way that interferes with its operation or security.
The Invenio name, logo and the design of this site are protected. Photographs are used with permission and remain the property of their owners.

sections.heading: Bookings and third parties
paragraphs: Bookings are made with the owner or the agency that represents the property, under their terms. Invenio may act as an agent or as a platform; the booking confirmation will make the contracting party clear.
We are not responsible for the availability, accuracy or performance of third-party websites linked from this site.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of this website. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited under Spanish law, including liability for fraud or for death or personal injury caused by negligence.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Spanish law. If you are a consumer, you may also rely on the mandatory protections of the law in your country of residence. Disputes will be heard by the courts of Ibiza, unless the law requires otherwise.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these terms: find@inveniohomes.com · Invenio Homes S.L., Santa Eulària des Riu, Ibiza.
